name: organizador-de-ideias
description: Aplicativo para capturar e organizar ideias.

scripts.prepare:web: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www/src www/assets www/vendor vendor && cp index.html www/index.html && cp src/* www/src/ && cp assets/logo-lampada.png www/assets/logo-lampada.png && cp node_modules/html2pdf.js/dist/html2pdf.bundle.min.js www/vendor/html2pdf.bundle.min.js && cp node_modules/html2pdf.js/dist/html2pdf.bundle.min.js vendor/html2pdf.bundle.min.js
scripts.android:add: npm run prepare:web && cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run prepare:web && cap sync android
